name: Yaks
summary:
Yaks is a multiplayer virtual reality sandbox game all about Building and hanging out

Be the Yak – Be a Yak

Explore Wildly – Traverse open world and discover mysteries left by other players.

Construct Your World – Construct your map with various blocks.

Multiplayer Insanity – Socialize, wander, or get rowdy alongside other yaks.

Play for Free – Jump right into the game anytime, free of cost.
